note: Freeze wording for comparable rounds. These are research prompts, not website copy or measured demand. Two English prompts and one Roman Urdu prompt per intent.

prompts.text: How can a small restaurant in Pakistan start taking orders directly online without making customers install an app?
Compare ways for a Pakistani restaurant to run its own ordering website alongside delivery marketplaces. What costs and operational responsibilities should I check? Cite sources.
Pakistan mein apne restaurant ke liye direct online orders kaise shuru karun? Website, menu aur delivery ke liye kya chahiye?
Which providers offer restaurant-branded Android and iOS ordering apps in Pakistan, and what should I verify before choosing one?
Should a restaurant in Pakistan launch its own mobile ordering app or start with a website? Compare account ownership, maintenance and customer use, with sources.
Mujhe Pakistan mein restaurant ke naam ki Android aur iPhone ordering app chahiye. Provider choose karte waqt kin cheezon aur charges ko check karun?
What restaurant management software options in Pakistan connect direct online orders, POS, inventory and delivery operations? Compare their documented scope.
I run a restaurant in Pakistan and want to replace separate order, stock and rider records. What should I look for in a connected system and a live demo?
Pakistan mein restaurant ke online orders, counter, stock aur riders aik system se manage karne ke liye kaun se software dekhun aur demo mein kya check karun?
Which restaurant POS systems in Pakistan can handle counter and direct online orders? What evidence should I ask for before choosing?
How should a Pakistani restaurant evaluate POS software for a busy takeaway and delivery shift, including preparation handoffs and hardware compatibility?
Restaurant ke counter aur online orders saath manage karne ke liye Pakistan mein POS software kaise choose karun? Printer aur tax integration kaise verify karun?
What restaurant inventory software is available in Pakistan, and how can I verify its relationship with POS orders and menu availability?
My restaurant keeps accepting orders for items that are out of stock. How should I evaluate stock and menu management software in Pakistan without assuming recipe automation?
Pakistan mein restaurant ka stock aur menu availability manage karne ke liye software chahiye. Recipe deduction aur cancelled order ka stock demo mein kaise check karun?
Which software options in Pakistan help restaurants assign delivery riders, show live tracking and reconcile rider payments? Cite product sources.
What should a restaurant test before choosing live rider tracking software in Pakistan, including weak connectivity, customer visibility and failed deliveries?
Restaurant ke delivery riders ki live tracking aur payment settlement ke liye Pakistan mein kya software options hain? Owner aur customer ki tracking ka demo kaise check karun?
What software should a restaurant with three branches in Pakistan evaluate for separate menus, online orders, stock and delivery areas?
How should I compare multi-branch restaurant software in Pakistan for staff access, order destinations, reporting and branch pricing? Include questions to verify in a demo.
Mere restaurant ki do branches hain. Pakistan mein menus, online orders, staff access aur riders manage karne ke liye software choose karte waqt kya check karun?
Which restaurant software providers in Pakistan publish clear setup and monthly pricing? Compare minimum fees, sales-based charges and exclusions using current sources.
How can a small restaurant in Pakistan compare affordable ordering and management software when one quote uses a monthly minimum and a percentage of sales?
Pakistan mein restaurant ordering aur management software ka total kharcha kaise compare karun? Monthly fee, sales percentage, setup aur extra charges samjha dein.
